How it works

A story made from where you are.

  1. 01 Read a short illustrated chapter.
  2. 02 Step away from the screen and find something outside.
  3. 03 An open CLIP model interprets the photo in your browser.
  4. 04 Your discovery becomes part of every chapter that follows.

The model downloads on first use and is cached by your browser. If it cannot load, you can always name the object yourself.

Optional scene director

Let Gemma direct the atmosphere.

Gemma 3 270M will read the current chapter and your discovered artifact, then choose the scene's atmosphere. The moving illustration is rendered locally with CSS and SVG.
